name: @speedora/multimodal-reasoning
description: Stateless module (JSON-in/JSON-out): AI Intelligence v4 Phase 2 - correlates a timestamp with already-computed OcrTextTrack/ObjectTrack entries concurrent with it (findConcurrentEvidence), grounding an LLM-detected moment with on-screen evidence. See docs/ai/intelligence-v4.md. Pure/synchronous, no DB/queue/LLM access at all; see root ARCHITECTURE.md. Extracted standalone (not buried inside packages/semantic-events) since the roadmap names further future consumers (Emotional Arc/Retention Curve, Virality Engine).
